caption: The drawing depicts a single vase centered on a plain, beige background. The vase has a flared rim, a gently curving body that narrows at the neck and then widens into a rounded middle before tapering slightly toward a broad, flat base. The vase appears to be made of a transparent or light-colored material and is decorated with an etched or engraved floral and leaf motif. The decorative pattern features branches with clusters of small, round berries, elongated leaves, and small flowers distributed along the upper, middle, and lower sections of the vase. Shading has been used to suggest the reflective and translucent qualities of the vase, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. In the bottom right corner, the text "JOHN DANA AP. 27, 1936" is written, and a small, faint ruler or scale is drawn at the bottom left.
title: Hurricane Shade
